When calculating resource generation it is important to remember some resource generation is multiplicative, others are additive (because Blizzard).
Here is the formula for calculating resource generation:
(1 + Res Gen Affix.n1% + Res Gen Affix.n2% + Res Gen Affix.n... + Res Gen Magic Node.n1% + Res Gen Magic Node.n3% + Res Gen Magic Node.n3%) - 1

What are Cap1 & Cap2 Movement Speeds?

, the game changed Movement speed cap from a hard cap of 200% to a Cap1 & Cap2 type system (similar to attack speed). Unlike Attack Speed (Cap1) and Cast Speed (Cap2) there is not a different tag word to easily decipher which is which for Movement Speed. Instead the different caps are denoted by +Movement Speed% (Cap 1) and Movement Speed %[x] (Cap 2). Each Cap is 100%, for a total of 300% Movement Speed possible, with a base movement speed of 100%.
